case: interval[] parameter, CSV and SQL replay across IntervalStyle configurations
contract: The source interval[] is read with IntervalStyle postgres_verbose and contains mixed-sign year/month/day/time fields, microseconds, a zero interval and SQL NULL.
The source type and array_send bytes are captured from PostgreSQL before changing the transaction to IntervalStyle iso_8601.
Rebinding the driver result, rebinding its CSV field, and replaying the SQL export after the style change all preserve the source array_send bytes.
The temporary target table is rolled back after verification.
